# GitHub Project Files

This folder contains repository automation and collaboration templates.

## Contents

- `workflows/tests.yml`: installs the package and runs the fast test suite on push and pull request.
- `pull_request_template.md`: asks contributors to document validation and artifact impact.
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`: separates bug reports from experiment proposals.

Keep this folder focused on GitHub behavior. Project documentation belongs in `docs/` or the relevant folder-level `README.md`.
